# AppFlowy

> AppFlowy is an open-source AI collaborative workspace — an alternative to Notion and Confluence where teams write docs, run wikis, and manage projects without giving up control of their data. It runs offline-first, can be self-hosted, and is available on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and the browser.

Key things to know:

- Open source (AppFlowy-IO/AppFlowy on GitHub), open-core, with cloud and self-hosted plans.
- Local-first: data stays on device by default and syncs when you want it to.
- AI is built in and model-agnostic — use AppFlowy AI, a local on-device model, or bring your own provider.
- AppFlowy also publishes standalone Flutter building blocks (AppFlowy Editor, AppFlowy Board) for developers.

## Product

- [Home](https://appflowy.com/): Overview of the AI collaborative workspace, features, and platforms.
- [Download](https://appflowy.com/download): Installers for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android.
- [Pricing](https://appflowy.com/pricing): Cloud and self-hosted plans for individuals and teams.
- [Templates](https://appflowy.com/templates): Community and official templates by category.
- [What's new](https://appflowy.com/what-is-new): Latest releases and product changes.
- [AppFlowy Blocks](https://appflowy.com/appflowy-blocks): Standalone building blocks — AppFlowy Editor and AppFlowy Board — for developers building their own apps.

## Compare

- [Notion vs AppFlowy](https://appflowy.com/compare/notion-vs-appflowy): Self-hosted, open-core alternative to Notion.
- [AppFlowy vs Confluence](https://appflowy.com/compare/appflowy-vs-confluence): Alternative to Confluence Data Center for self-hosted teams.
- [AppFlowy vs AFFiNE](https://appflowy.com/compare/appflowy-vs-affine): Self-hosted Notion alternative comparison for enterprise teams.
- [AppFlowy vs Docmost](https://appflowy.com/compare/appflowy-vs-docmost): On-premises wiki and docs comparison.
- [AppFlowy vs Outline](https://appflowy.com/compare/appflowy-vs-outline): Self-hosted enterprise wiki comparison.
